avis.titre: Senstive Skin - Tricks to Making it Work!
avis.texte: I ordered this product about a month ago and really like it. I have very sensitive skin and the tinted spf I tried before this one made my whole face itchy and caused sneezing. I have been using this tinted spf almost every day and my skin is been totally calm. From reading reviews I found some people have a problem with color transfer/ the product not fully "setting". I have not really had this problem any more with this product than any other tinted product but I do have a few tricks that I use to set this better on my skin. 1) I apply a good amount of moisturizer right before applying this (when my skin has dry spots this does cake on those areas) 2) I apply two pea-sized amounts (in two layers) and get a really nice amount of coverage 3) if I am in a rush, I lightly blow dry my face after applying this - that seems to make it set quicker/not transfer to clothes as easily. I really love this product overall and hope it can last more than a month as it is a little pricey for the size tube!
